text:
elena: Heads up — since the proxy bump last night we've started seeing TLS handshake drops from APAC services to downstream model routers. Dropped connections spike ~03:14 UTC. Anyone else seeing this? :thinking:

samir: seeing same. logs show `tls: handshake failure` followed by `unsupported protocol` from `conn-proxy-03`. Could be cipher mismatch with new openssl patch.

auditor-bot: Audit alert: 5 failed TLS handshakes from apac-prod between 03:14-03:21 UTC. Incident ID INC-21477. Log link: https://redwood.logs/urls/INC-21477

charles: if openssl changed default cipher order, our sidecars might be attempting TLSv1.2-only with strict ciphers. Did we enable `TLS_ECDHE`-only profile in proxy config during rollout?

maya: I changed `proxy_tls_profile` in terraform to `strict-modern` for latency reasons. Didn't think it'd break inter-region. oops.

kai: quick mitigation: revert to `compatibility` profile for APAC proxy canary and re-evaluate. Also need to check that cert-issuer service account still has KMS unwrap permissions — otherwise cert chain validation fails after reissue.

elena: good call. plan: 1) canary rollback APAC proxies to `compatibility` (5% -> 25% -> 100%), 2) add audit hooks for KMS unwrap and cert issuance, 3) run vuln triage on openssl package, 4) postmortem if rollout caused client failures.

samir: add me for the rollback. small snippet for rollback in console:
```
# canary rollback
kubectl set env deploy/proxy --namespace=apac PROXY_TLS_PROFILE=compatibility
kubectl rollout status deploy/proxy -w
```

charles: on KMS: current IAM role for `cert-issuer` lacks `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` in apac-kms key policy. I'll open a PR to add it with strict condition: resource.name is the apac key only.

auditor-bot: Added request: ACL-21477 by charles. Audit will surface the operation to `audit-sink/tls-operations` with retention 90d.

auditor-bot: Note: Please attach the `kms-access` change to the RBAC change ticket before merging to track approvals.

maya: also flagging this for vulnerability triage — openssl 1.1.1 -> 3.x had behavior change for cipher negotiation. triage checklist started here: https://redwood.internal/triage/21477

kai: for incident response, let's add a temporary mitigation in the routing layer: route traffic from apac->model-router to eu fallback if handshake fails >3x in 10s. That buys time for rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: proxy-canary rollback started by samir. pipeline: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/12345

elena: thanks team. charles, can you also include an audit log sample once you add KMS IAM? need it for compliance.

charles: will do. I'll post the audit log snippet here once granted.

samir: after rollback, let's run an end-to-end check: `openssl s_client -connect model-router.apac:443 -cipher 'ECDHE' -tls1_2` and confirm handshake + cert chain.

elena: closing — moving this to `incident` channel after we stabilize. will file postmortem template. :white_check_mark:
